creature_text.Text: Join me! Unleash your true power. Do not let the weak hold you back!
Behold the power of the Deceiver. Behold the full power of the demon within!
I am a GOD! KNEEL BEFORE ME!
I am through with this charade! Your soul will feed the Twinblades.
Ah, Jergosh, at last! Bring me the Book!
You have both done well to acquire these artifacts. Your positions in the Shadow Council are all but assured.

With the Book of Medivh, the Eye of Dalaran, and the Scepter of Sargeras, we will rip open the gates to all the demon worlds! We will bring the full power of the Legion to bear on this pitiful planet.
I will go through the portal and act as a stabilizing anchor on Argus. You must focus the ritual energy through the scepter, widening the breach and creating a myriad of portals.
<grim chuckle>Ahh, I only need ONE of you for the ritual. "Discuss" the matter quickly, and be ready...
Congratulations on your "promotion," Jergosh. Now let us begin. Take up the scepter... and be careful! This power can tear worlds asunder.
creature_text.comment: Image of Gul'dan to Phantomflame Infernal

creature_text.Text: The time has come! Begin the incantations. Jergosh, focus the scepter on the portal. Today we usher in the end of this world!
Jergosh, what are-- YOU! You will pay for this deception! I will see you dead!
Uh... great master! Which of us is to wield the scepter?
So, we are to be foes after all. Pity, you would have made an excellent servant!
You have yet to experience my true power!
Slain... by an lowborn... how beneath me...
